read.thesis: Bank read, not a capital-cycle story: Q1 ROTE 18.7% and Hong Kong deposit/wealth momentum, but ECL guidance raised to ~45bps on Middle East conflict and one concentrated fraud-linked private credit loss (~$0.4bn).

utilisation.quote: We’re not targeting a NIM. There’s no secret NIM target that we haven’t told you about.

triggers.label: ECL guidance raised; ~45bps for year
triggers.quote: the total amount of the ECL guidance has gone up.

triggers.label: Private credit fraud-linked ~$0.4bn stage 3 hit
triggers.quote: The learning in this case has been that, even though we’ve said quite clearly that private credit in itself is not something which contributes significantly to our growth

triggers.label: Wealth net new money strong in Q1
triggers.quote: Overall it’s been a strong quarter, and the growth that we’ve seen in our Wealth business is across all pillars.

triggers.label: Banking NII upgraded ~$1bn
triggers.quote: Banking NII will be dependent on customer behaviours, but, so far, we see strength in deposits and the rest holding up.

guidance.quote: the total amount of the ECL guidance has gone up.

guidance.metric: Gross cost growth / net cost growth
guidance.quote: On costs, we said to you gross costs growth is 3%, but there will be savings from simplification of 2%, therefore the net is 1%.

guidance.value: ~$604bn, not seeking to increase except HKD
guidance.quote: We’re not seeking to increase. One of the exceptions to that is Hong Kong dollar.

prior_guidance_check.quote: we said to you gross costs growth is 3%, but there will be savings from simplification of 2%, therefore the net is 1%.

red_flags.label: Concentrated private credit fraud-linked stage 3 loss
red_flags.quote: the overall quantum was not that different, but it was more concentrated in one specific name.

red_flags.label: Management says cannot rule out further losses in private credit
red_flags.quote: I cannot say that there will never be another loss in this space

evasions.quote: we’re not going to give any more details.
I’m very happy to take a question directly on where we were in terms of this particular exposure
